title: The brief for Thursday
do: Open Calendar, click Steering on Thursday, press Get the brief. The Prep section lands on the page; scroll to it.
offScript: That is outside what this demo can show. The six things it can do are listed in Settings, under Demo.

input.append:

input.rationale: Four people in the room, and the record shows what each of them has not heard since 2026-07-09: Åsa the October date, Marcus that the Google button is live, and everyone that PAY-210 still has no date.

turns.text: The brief is on the steering page: what changed since 2026-07-09, what shipped, what Henrik owes, and what Marcus will raise. One thing to do before you walk in: tell Åsa the October date yourself, before Marcus does ([[people/asa-lindgren]]). Nothing waits and nothing was sent.
